name: Biblios: Scriptorium Duel of Three
summary: Three scribes take turns as the active seat. Each round the active seat secretly keeps one of two drawn cards, and the other two seats bid gold for the other card. Church cards shift colour values, and each colour scores for the single player with the strictly highest total.

player.meaning: cards kept as the active player; never announced until the end
lots this player won at auction
sum of the red card values held (hand plus bought)
sum of the blue card values held
sum of the green card values held
gold coins; hidden during play, revealed at scoring, used as the tie-break
secret bid this round; announced after both bids are in, then reset to 0
true if the player gained a Church card this round and must make a Church choice
the Church choice made this round
victory points, scored at the end

game.meaning: the shuffled deck; its order is unknown to all, and its composition is public
the two cards drawn this round; shown only to the active player
VP value of red, kept between 1 and 5
VP value of blue, kept between 1 and 5
VP value of green, kept between 1 and 5

setup: The deck is filled with the 24 cards listed and is drawn from at random, which is equivalent to one shuffle; it is never reshuffled.
Each player gets gold 4, red/blue/green 0, an empty hand and an empty bought list, bid 0, church_pending false, church_choice 'none', an empty message and vp 0.
The table gets vp_red=3, vp_blue=3, vp_green=3, round=0, lot='none' and drawn empty.
Each player is sent their own state.

round.effect: round += 1; active_seat = ((round-1) mod 3)+1; announce the round and the active seat.
Two cards are drawn at random from deck into drawn and removed from deck. They are shown only to the active seat.

round.answer: one of the two cards in drawn
round.effect: The chosen card is appended to the active player's hand. If it is red-v, blue-v or green-v, that colour total += v; if it is gold-v, gold += v; if it is church, church_pending = true. The choice is not announced.
The other drawn card becomes lot and is announced to everyone; drawn is emptied.
message is set for each player; then broadcast {"to": "all", "text": "Seat {seat} says: {value}"}. Nothing said is binding.

round.answer: a whole number from 0 to the bidder's current gold
round.effect: bid is set for each bidder and stays secret until both bids are in.

If one bid is strictly greater than the other and at least 1, that bidder: gold -= bid; the active player's gold += that bid; lot is appended to bought; a colour lot adds its value to that colour total, a gold lot adds its value to gold, and a church lot sets church_pending = true. If the bids are equal (including 0-0), nobody pays and the lot is discarded. Both bids and the result (the winner and the price, or 'discarded') are announced. Then both bids are reset to 0 and lot = 'none'.

round.who: every player with church_pending true (at most two)
round.answer: one of: red up, red down, blue up, blue down, green up, green down
round.effect: church_choice is set for each chooser.

For each colour C: vp_C = min(5, max(1, vp_C + (count of 'C up') - (count of 'C down'))). All choices are announced with who made them. Then church_pending = false and church_choice = 'none' for everyone.

If round == 12, go to the end: reveal every hand, colour total and gold. For each colour C, a player whose C total is strictly greater than both other players' C totals gets vp += vp_C; a tied top total scores no one. Then the game ends. Otherwise continue.

ending.condition: round == 12 after the Church step, with colour scoring applied
ending.decided_by: The player with the highest vp wins. A tie on vp goes to the player with more remaining gold. Players still tied share the win, which is the source's draw.

rules.text: At the start the deck holds exactly 24 cards: red, blue and green each with values 1,1,2,2,3,4, plus gold-2, gold-2, gold-3, gold-3 and 2 church cards.
At the start each player has gold 4, red/blue/green 0, vp 0, an empty hand and an empty bought list.
At the start vp_red, vp_blue and vp_green are each 3.
In round r the active seat is ((r-1) mod 3)+1, so over 12 rounds each seat is active exactly 4 times.
Each round, 2 cards are removed from the deck into drawn, and only the active player is shown them.
When the active player keeps a colour card of value v, that colour total rises by v and the card goes to their hand unannounced.
When the active player keeps gold-v, their gold rises by v; when they keep church, their church_pending becomes true.
The drawn card that was not kept becomes the lot and is announced to everyone, and drawn is emptied.
Every round all 3 players simultaneously write one message, and all messages are then shown to everyone with the writer's seat.
Only the 2 non-active seats bid, simultaneously, each a whole number from 0 to their current gold.

When one bid is strictly higher and at least 1, that bidder pays the bid from their gold to the active player's gold and gains the lot in bought, with its colour value, gold value or church_pending applied.
When the two bids are equal (for example 2 and 2, or 0 and 0), nobody pays and the lot is discarded.
Both bids and the auction result are announced, then the bids reset to 0 and lot becomes 'none'.
Each player with church_pending true chooses one of red up, red down, blue up, blue down, green up, green down, simultaneously with any other chooser.
Each colour's VP value changes by (ups minus downs) this round and is then clamped once to 1..5: for example 5 with 1 up stays 5, and 3 with 1 up and 1 down stays 3.
After the Church step, every church_pending becomes false and every church_choice becomes 'none'.
The game ends after round 12, when the deck is empty.
At the end, a player whose total in a colour is strictly greater than both others' gains that colour's VP value in vp; if the top total is tied, nobody scores that colour.
The highest vp wins; tied vp is broken by more gold; a further tie is a shared win (draw).

offers.question: Keep a card
offers.options: exactly the two cards currently in drawn (if both are the same card, that card)

offers.question: Bid on the lot
offers.who: the two non-active seats; the active seat is not asked
offers.options: whole numbers from 0 to the bidder's current gold

offers.question: Church choice
offers.who: only seats with church_pending true; seats without a pending Church are not asked
offers.options: red up, red down, blue up, blue down, green up, green down

choices.why: The designer fixed 3. The rotation ((r-1) mod 3)+1, the two-bidder auction and 4 active turns each over a 24-card deck only work at exactly 3. At 3, one rival always sits out of each auction, which creates kingmaking tension.

choices.what: Talk kept as a simultaneous poll with broadcast
choices.why: The source requires simultaneous messages. Talk earns its place because players disagree about prices and Church moves, and they can bluff about their hidden keeps.
This puts vp first and gold as the tie-break. Total gold can never exceed 22, so 1000 separates the two cleanly. Equal values share the win, which is the source's draw.
The rules reveal all gold at scoring, and gold decides ties.

choices.what: Drawing two random cards stands in for taking the top two of a once-shuffled deck
choices.why: This is equivalent in distribution, and the deck order is unknown to all anyway.

choices.what: The card values are listed as counts per value in parameters
choices.why: Parameters must be numbers, so the value lists 1,1,2,2,3,4 and 2,2,3,3 are written as how many cards carry each value.

simplifications.what: Comparing the two bids, and comparing colour totals at the end, use table helper values (for example the top and second bid, and the maximum of the other players' totals)
simplifications.why: The engine has no direct player-to-player attribute compare; this is the documented workaround.

simplifications.what: Card effects are applied by parsing the card name (colour and value) with conditional operations
simplifications.why: There is no card-type lookup; the cards are text in lists.

simplifications.what: The end-of-game reveal and colour scoring are carried out within the final check step
simplifications.why: The step list is flat, but the scoring is pure arithmetic, so it can be done with conditional updates when round == 12.
